Title: Assembly page lists the expected columns
Expected Result: The 'All Breakers in Assembly' heading is visible and the table shows columns Production Order, Breaker Type, Current Rating, Control Voltage, Customer, Status

Title: Testing page lists the expected columns
Expected Result: The 'All Breakers in Testing' heading is visible and the table shows columns Production Order, Breaker Type, Control Voltage, Current Rating, Customer Name, Testing Status

Title: Reports submenu expands in the sidebar
Preconditions: User is signed in on the dashboard
Steps:
1. Open the Dashboard
2. Click the expand arrow next to Reports in the sidebar
Expected Result: The Reports submenu opens and shows links 'Test Reports' and 'Labor Hours Summary Reports'

Title: Create New Order opens the package upload dialog
Steps:
1. Open the Production Orders page
2. Click 'Create New Order'
Expected Result: The 'Create New Production Order' dialog is visible and its Submit button is disabled until a ZIP is uploaded

Title: Create New Order dialog can be closed
Steps:
1. Open the Production Orders page
2. Click 'Create New Order'
3. Click Close in the dialog
Expected Result: The 'Create New Production Order' dialog is no longer visible

Title: Lookup can switch to search by customer name
Steps:
1. Open the Lookup page
2. Select 'Look Up by Customer Name'
Expected Result: The 'Look Up by Customer Name' option is selected and 'Look Up by Production Order #' is not selected

Title: Settings lists its configuration sections
Expected Result: The Settings menu shows User Management, Roles and Permissions, Assembly Configuration and Testing Configuration
